# CodeGraph Context

CodeGraph Context is a hosted remote MCP for code graph MCP for AI coding.

Website: https://codegraphcontext.clauxel.com/
Docs pattern reference: https://github.com/clauxel/MiroFish
Primary keyword: code graph MCP for AI coding
Type: MCP
Default plan: team
MCP endpoint: https://codegraphcontext.clauxel.com/mcp
Server card: https://codegraphcontext.clauxel.com/server-card.json
Registry name: com.clauxel.codegraphcontext/codegraphcontext-mcp
Tools: repo_graph_query, symbol_impact_path, branch_context_pack, dependency_hotspot_report

Public boundary: docs-only repository; no production source code or secrets.
